summary: Independent review confirms package results for issue-108 carbon localization at hour 3,289: existing-log decomposition and non-perturbing TEMP_DIAGNOSTIC probe (run-037) verify that exactly half the -2.1516e-6 g C residual arises from root CO2/CH4 vented to the atmosphere in plant_root_gas_transport.advance (atmosphere_to_root_c = -1.07581e-6 g C). Probe lines did not perturb run (failure row identical). Remaining booking shortfall and Ca/Na/K cations properly documented as open follow-ups. No gate promoted.
